notes_for_editor: Only one list line (GA270) supports this record. The tags 'gfc-021' and 'BLL-50809' are printed as on the list and are not expanded there; 'gfc' is probably the Georgia Forestry Commission numbering, but no source here says so. The record's register entry GFC US 21 matches gfc-021. No build, design, staffing, height or current-status source was found, and no NHLR or FFLOS Georgia entry matches (both cached lists checked). The list gives two Wrightsboro entries about 436 m apart; no source says whether they are one structure or two, so this may duplicate us-ga-wrightsboro. The record's elevation of 140.5 m equals 461 ft, so the list's elevation column is in feet.
